# Kubernetes

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from kubernetes/lang.json and kubernetes/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Kubernetes code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Kubernetes project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Kubernetes package from [`kubernetes/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/kubernetes/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//kubernetes:defs.bzl", "kubernetes_library")

kubernetes_library(
    name = "kubernetes",
    srcs = ["app.yaml"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//kubernetes:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//kubernetes:defs.bzl", "kubernetes_library", "kubernetes_schemas")
```

### `kubernetes_library`

Owns the Kubernetes manifests of one package for dx lint (kubeconform).

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Kubernetes manifest files of this package; every document needs apiVersion and kind. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Other manifest libraries this package depends on. |

### `kubernetes_schemas`

Stages offline JSON schemas and the kubeconform settings for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crd_schemas` | `label_keyed_string_dict` | no | CRD schema files named <kind>_<version>.json mapped to their API group. |
| `kubernetes_version` | `string` | yes | Label for the version the schema files describe, as X.Y.Z; the files decide it. |
| `schemas` | `label_list` | no | Core schema files named like kubernetes-json-schema, such as deployment-apps-v1.json. |
| `skip_kinds` | `string_list` | no | Resource kinds kubeconform skips. |

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Kubernetes:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `kubeconform`, `trivy_config`, `yamlfmt` |
| Ecosystems | none |
| Manifests | none |
| Lockfiles | none |

## Platforms

Kubernetes builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64
